messages:
emily: Hey @kevin_voltcloud — can we sketch a lightweight handover for VoltCloud hardware incidents? thinking: one shared channel + short war-room checklist, then formal postmortem. low overhead. thoughts?
kevin_voltcloud: yes we can do that. prefer a temporary shared channel per incident so we keep history scoped. naming: #vc-sev-<incident-id>. agree on a single owner from each side.
raj: +1 on temp channel. need clear on who pages SRE and who runs the bridge. also want a runbook link attached for the first responder. e.g. <https://redwood.com/runbooks/voltcloud-sev>
maria: for partnerships side we should pin a "roles" message in the channel with owner, badge (who escalates to PM/legal/comms). we can maintain a template message for pinning.
sara: also add an announcement template so support/customer-facing comms are consistent. include allowed public statements and what requires legal signoff.
emily: draft checklist idea below (super short) — please comment/edits: 
````
1) Confirm impact (customers, regions)
2) Create shared channel #vc-sev-<id> and invite oncall + partner leads
3) Assign Redwood owner / VoltCloud owner
4) Triage & mitigations (temporary workarounds)
5) Escalate to Dedicated/Private infra if hardware fault
6) Capture logs + start postmortem doc
7) Close with shared RCA within 72h
````
raj: minor nit: step 5 should include escalation matrix. propose: Redwood SRE pager -> eng-oncall -> eng-platform escalation. add contact tree snippet.
dan: for high-sev we need a phone tree too (partners sometimes want voice). suggest: +1 to provide a phone/pager list in the pinned message. I'll draft the phone tree.
kevin_voltcloud: VoltCloud SLA: critical ack goal 1h, full incident response 4h. we'll add our oncall alias volt-oncall@voltcloud.com and our emergency Pager number +1-555-901-234.
maria: regarding channel lifecycle: auto-archive after 30 days of inactivity, with an audit tag. we should record the channel mapping in a shared spreadsheet for billing/credits.
ops-bot: Automated: New shared channel created -> #vc-1955554321-sev (created by emily). Reminder: pin runbook and roles.
raj: short ops commands for oncall to create channel and invites: 
````
# create channel (admin)
slack-cli channels.create name=vc-1955554321-sev private=true
slack-cli channels.invite channel=vc-1955554321-sev users=raj,emily,kevin_voltcloud,maria,sara
````
kevin_voltcloud: we'll mirror that on VoltCloud side (create shared channel link and post our contact card). also please add a quick intake form so we capture affected customer IDs up front.
emily: good call. next steps: 1) maria & kevin to finalize pinned role template, 2) raj & dan to add contact tree and phone list, 3) sara to draft announcement template. can we aim for a short sync Thurs 10am PT to sign off? :calendar:  
kevin_voltcloud: Thurs 10am PT works for me. thanks all. :thumbsup:
emily: thanks everyone — I'll drop the meeting invite and a one-pager in this channel before Thurs.
ops-bot: Reminder: please attach the postmortem template when closing the channel.
